title: Anamarie Avila Farias
intro:
Anamarie Avila Farias (Democratic Party) is a member of the California State Assembly, representing District 15. She assumed office on December 2, 2024. Her current term ends on December 7, 2026.
Avila Farias (Democratic Party) is running for re-election to the California State Assembly to represent District 15. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
